failure_modes: A temporal_teacher blend could displace surrounding coordinates along a non-monotone observed-node contrast (multiple sign changes, strong sign conflicts, no accepted polynomial), which is not a validated spatial gradient and could degrade final predicted affinity.
Treating the temporal derivative of the observed-node contrast as a spatial coordinate gradient would be an unsupported interpretation and could produce incoherent coordinate motion.
Selecting an unvalidated blend scalar (C009/C010/C011) without evidence of affinity benefit risks a change that is not defensible under the affinity-first objective.
No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied, so any claimed affinity benefit from a temporal recipe cannot be verified in this turn.
result.rationale: Analyst's temporal evidence (continuous:0 landmark_00_soft_mass, 4 sign changes, first_rate_z positive / last_rate_z negative; continuous:2 landmark_00_local_dy, 6 sign changes, opposite rate signs) supports a time-conditioned coordinate contrast over a stationary one, so the registered temporal_teacher recipe (C009-C011) is the only permitted alternative that changes teacher coordinates/regional attention rather than dose. However, the offered temporal choices are blends of the static reward with an observed-teacher term, and the incumbent already uses teacher_neighbors=4 with teacher_score_beta=0 and a static endpoint pointcloud reward; the evidence shows strong sign conflicts and no accepted polynomial (continuous:1, continuous:3), so the observed-node linear representation is the only validated description and no extrapolation is allowed. The evidence does not establish that a blended observed-teacher term improves final predicted affinity over the incumbent static reward, and the objective is affinity-first with coordinate control only. Per D4.1, an edit is chosen only when evidence provides a defensible expected advantage; here the temporal evidence justifies the direction of H001 but not a specific blend value, and the registered choices C009/C010/C011 are unvalidated scalars. Retaining the incumbent is therefore the defensible choice. Per D1.2, this is a decision not to change teacher coordinates or regional attention; no dose change is proposed either. Per D4.2, the predicted failure of a temporal blend is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: the observed-node contrast features carry strong sign conflicts (9 for local_dx, 7 for local_dz, 4 for local_dy) and no accepted polynomial, so a time-conditioned teacher term could drive surrounding coordinates along a non-monotone contrast that is not a validated spatial gradient, and a temporal derivative must not be interpreted as a spatial gradient. That predicted failure, combined with the affinity-first priority, keeps the incumbent.
